text: Security-heavy phases 007-per-bot-apps and 008-vault: are threat model, secret lifecycle, storage, injection and leak checks architected deeply enough, and should either become a phase parent with children?

Conversations and skills (010, 009) and memory (005): are the user-facing flows designed (chat transcript format, @bot routing, mockups of terminal and chat messages, prompt assembly order and budgets, injection boundaries) deeply enough to one-shot?

Verification phases 012-manual-testing-scenarios, 013-skilled-and-doc-alignment and 014-deep-review: are their scenario lists, alignment targets, review dimensions, executor waves and stop rules concrete enough to run without decisions, and do the build phases leave them the hooks they need?
